docs.text: ETA-IL: passport of a visa-exempt country valid at least 3 months from arrival; stay up to 90 days
Photocopy of travel document valid at least for the visa period and beyond departure from Israel
Recent passport photo against a white background
Round-trip tickets
Health insurance valid in Israel for the entire visit
Proof of accommodation: host letter with address, phone and ID number, or hotel confirmation
Proof of monetary means (e.g. bank statements for the last three months)

docs.text: Completed Entry visa request form
Photocopy of the invited person's passport, including visas to other countries
Photocopy of the inviting Israeli resident's ID
Liability document stating duration, reasons for the visit and departure date
Official documents showing the relationship between inviter and invitee
Minors: signed affidavit from both parents or legal guardian
Nationals of countries defined as high-risk: resume form for security clearance

docs.text: Request submitted in Israel to the Interior Ministry by the employer; approval sent to the consulate
Expert's resume and diplomas/certificates (translated into Hebrew and notarised if not in Hebrew or English)
Foreign company without Israeli branch: power of attorney
Local company: accountant's report that the company is active
Certified copy of form 102 submitted to the National Insurance Institute for the last three months
Letter of explanation of the need for the expert worker
